answer: Make each identity take sole, week-long stewardship of a distinct communal plot, climbing a shared trellis, repairing a copper gate and watching a crystal marker for rain, pests and thieves arriving at unpredictable hours and demanding an answer within the hour. One operator running fifty shells faces a serial bottleneck: real stewards respond at scattered times with plot-specific choices, while clones either miss windows when he sleeps or tend every plot in synchronized bursts, exposing common control. Pay only plots that finish healthier than they began.
